mapper.insert: INSERT INTO shipments ( id, order_id, checkout_id, customer_id, shop_id, status, tracking_code, shipping_method, shipping_fee, total_weight_gram, package_payload, pickup_name, pickup_phone, pickup_address, pickup_latitude, pickup_longitude, receiver_name, receiver_phone, receiver_address, receiver_latitude, receiver_longitude, estimated_delivery_at ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{orderId}, #{checkoutId}, #{customerId}, #{shopId}, #{status}, #{trackingCode}, #{shippingMethod}, #{shippingFee}, #{totalWeightGram}, CAST(#{packagePayload} AS JSONB), #{pickupName}, #{pickupPhone}, #{pickupAddress}, #{pickupLatitude}, #{pickupLongitude}, #{receiverName}, #{receiverPhone}, #{receiverAddress}, #{receiverLatitude}, #{receiverLongitude}, #{estimatedDeliveryAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, order_id, checkout_id, customer_id, shop_id, status, tracking_code, shipping_method, shipping_fee, total_weight_gram, package_payload::TEXT AS package_payload, pickup_name, pickup_phone, pickup_address, pickup_latitude, pickup_longitude, receiver_name, receiver_phone, receiver_address, receiver_latitude, receiver_longitude, estimated_delivery_at, picked_up_at, delivered_at, created_at, updated_at FROM shipments WHERE order_id = #{orderId}
